text_block_list.name: Sage Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Be careful, everyone.
The lair of an evil dragon lies just ahead.

text_block_list.name: Musketeer Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: The time is finally here... Hehe, it sends shivers down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Healer Craft
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, whaaat? Wait, wait!
Where... is this!? What is everyone holding!?"

text_block_list.name: Holy Knight Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean...? It's a weapon, obviously.
What's the matter, Craft?
The dragon is right in front of us. Lowering your guard is dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Healer Craft
text_block_list.text:
A weapon and a dragon...?
That sounds straight out of a fantasy novel—

text_block_list.name: Holy Knight Cesario
text_block_list.text: !! —Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Evil Dragon
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOHHH!

text_block_list.name: Sage Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—I've cast a protective magic barrier!
Now's our chance!!"

text_block_list.name: Musketeer Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
I'll hit 'em with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Healer Craft
text_block_list.text: Um, um...! W-What should I do...!

text_block_list.name: Holy Knight Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Stay calm.
Close your eyes, offer a prayer, and wave your wand.

text_block_list.name: Healer Craft
text_block_list.text: Close your eyes... and offer a prayer...... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Healer Craft
text_block_list.text: (Words of prayer are... welling up inside me...!)

text_block_list.name: Holy Knight Cesario
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Craft!!

text_block_list.name: Craft & Cesario
text_block_list.text: Holy Tiara Judgment!!

text_block_list.name: Evil Dragon
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
――Ah!!
Oh... it was a dream...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, that feeling just now...
I think I might've grasped something...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Line Craft's running
grew noticeably sharper.
